title: SkyrimNet SexLab
description:
Provides the actions and prompts needed to support sexlab animations in SkyrimNet.

## Features
- npc/hotkey can start sex, cuddle, punishment scenes
- ability add scene descriptions
- mini-sexgame
- Injury Engine support
- May ask/order/punish actor
- DOM support

## Required

- SexLab Framework (vanilla or P+; P+ Separate/enjoyment-wait scenes are capped so LLM scenes end)
- Papyrus MessageBox
- JContainers v4.2.13.1+
- SkyUI SE
- UIExtensions
 - UIExtensions_UITextEntryMenu_with_VR_support (VR)
- MageLight UI
 - Media Keys Fix
- Animation utilities: Pandora, XPMSSE, SL Animation Loader, Hug kill move fix for USSEP
- Ace Animations (cuddle/spooning)
author: goodprovider
changelog:
## 0.37.3 – 0.37.4

**Scene style**
- Gently / normally / forcefully set how fast enjoyment builds (80 / 100 / 110%), not animation speed
- HUD Num − / Num + step these levels; "Animation speed" settings are gone

**DOM slaves**
- The bar shows the DOM arousal step; optional "Display DOM slave enjoyment" lists the orgasm roll
- Slaves lead the stage last and aren't punished for stuck stages; narration and stamina follow DOM

**Animation chain**
- Scene Creator and Description Editor list the chain at the top; click to add/remove, ▲ / ▼ reorder
- New last animation pulldown: end, loop or NPC choice; picked animations play in turn
- The last-stage list marks the keys for the lines above (−) and below (+)

**Animation filter**
- Compact Scene Creator; tags show counts and cycle white / red / grey
- sexual, vaginal, oral, anal, bound, rape, necro get their own line; lists open least-played first

**Mini-game**
- Ask, order and punish wait for the target's reply; agreeing or refusing is narrated
- New "Maximum serial punishment rejects" (default 3): the NPC then gives in

**Compatibility (untested)**
- SkyrimNet 1.0.0: NPCs get scene context during sex again (1.1.1+ still recommended)
- A message names the hooks of a mod that keeps restarting SexLab scenes
- SexLab P+: Ctrl+click picks play only the last; a one-animation loop steps back a stage

**Bug fixes**
- Kiss or cuddle stuck on stage 1 with auto advance off
- HUD stage keys sometimes ignored; a double-clicked random start ran twice
- A busy game could reopen an ended scene
- Solo scenes could pick the other gender's masturbation animation
- A DOM slave's orgasm could end her partner's scene
- Magelight: reopening the WebUI quickly could swallow every key
- Ctrl+click in the Description Editor used only the last pick
